messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT: SLO breach detected on /generate-stream (p99 latency spike) from 2139991200 - automated page sent to #incidents. Metric: p99=2.8s (SLO=1.5s), streaming stalls observed in 12% of streams.
Jordan (oncall): saw the page, I'm on it. pinging Priya and Mike.
Priya Shah: on my way, grabbing logs. any customer-facing alerts?
CS Team: flagged 3 customers with elevated error rates (chat timeouts) via pagerduty ticket PD-9482.
Mike Chen: initial hunch: we shipped a precision-profile update to int8-low-sensitivity yesterday to canary; traffic ramped at 21:00 UTC. Could be quantization calibration fallout.
Jordan (oncall): can we confirm model variant mix? show recent rollout config.
Priya Shah: tailing runtime logs now. attaching sample stream stall trace: ```
[2026-02-12T21:07:43Z] req=abcd1234 model=gptx-6b@int8-low context=1024 tokens=512 stall=3000ms step=kv_fetch
[2026-02-12T21:07:44Z] req=efgh5678 model=gptx-6b@int8-low context=2048 tokens=1024 stall=3100ms step=attn_kernel
```
Lena Torres: looks like stalls correlate with longer contexts (>1024) and int8-low. fp16 routes show normal latencies.
Jordan (oncall): thumbs. Prioritize mitigation: 1) rollback precision profile for the canary pool, 2) route streaming traffic to fp16 pool for impacted customers, 3) increase logging for KV cache hit/miss. Who can execute rollback?
Mike Chen: I can push a rollback to the precision profile for the canary pool. prepping patch now.
Priya Shah: Routing change — we have a runtime route policy to prefer fp16 for streams when p99>1.8s. I can flip the policy for the customer tags impacted (cs:high-tier).
Jordan (oncall): do both in parallel. Start rollback first then routing; want minimal risk to throughput.
Mike Chen: rollback command run: ```
# rollback precision profile for pool canary-quant-a
redwoodctl deploy precision-profile set --pool canary-quant-a --profile gptx-6b@fp16-stable --reason "emergency rollback - p99 surge"
```
incident-bot: deploy started by Mike Chen at 2026-02-12T21:12:10Z. CI checks passed.
Priya Shah: routing rule toggle: ```
# update routing to prefer fp16 for streaming routes tagged cs:high-tier
redwoodctl routing update --route /generate-stream --preferred-variant fp16-stable --match-tags cs:high-tier --dry-run=false
```
Jordan (oncall): monitor SLO dashboard. Priya, Mike, keep me posted on p95/p99 every 2 min. I'll coordinate comms with CS.
CS Team: notifying affected customers with a short note: "We're investigating intermittent streaming stalls impacting latency. Engineers are rolling back a recent precision profile change; we'll update you in 30 minutes."
Priya Shah: p95 dropped slightly within 1 minute of routing change, p99 still elevated. Current: p95=420ms, p99=1.9s (was 2.8s).
Mike Chen: rollback finished at 21:16:02Z. Runtime reports canary pool now on fp16-stable.
incident-bot: rollback completed by Mike Chen at 2026-02-12T21:16:02Z.
Lena Torres: seeing immediate reduction in the long-context stalls on canary hosts. KV hit rate unchanged, but attn kernel latency back to baseline on fp16.
Jordan (oncall): good. keep routing preference for 10 more minutes to stabilize, then evaluate gradual re-introduction with stricter quant profile (higher calibration samples).
Priya Shah: increased debug sampling enabled for int8 paths to capture calibration metrics: ```
# enable extra calibration sampling
redwoodctl metrics set --path /runtime/quant/calib --sampling 1000
```
Mike Chen: starting a controlled re-roll later after collecting calibration samples and running regression evals on long-context prompts. For now, reverting canary change and marking the int8 profile as quarantined.
CS Team: customers updated at 21:25 UTC. No escalations to legal/enterprise yet. ticket PD-9482 updated.
Jordan (oncall): handoff note for next oncall: incident mitigated, rollback completed, monitoring stable but still watching p99. Next steps: postmortem, deeper calibration analysis, and refine rollout guardrails for precision profiles (auto-fallback thresholds).
Priya Shah: leaving a short runbook entry in #eng-runtime: "Precision profile rollout immediate mitigation": steps to rollback profile, route to fp16, enable sampling, and customer comms template.
Lena Torres: adding a metric alert tweak suggestion: trigger routing fallback earlier (p99>1.5s for 3 samples) and add context-length tags to routing policy.
Jordan (oncall): assigning follow-ups: Mike -> calibration analysis + repro tests; Priya -> runbook + routing guard; Lena -> alert tweaks + kernel telemetry. I'll create tracking issue INF-3127.
incident-bot: oncall handoff scheduled at 2026-02-12T22:00:00Z. Next oncall: Jordan -> Alex.B.
Jordan (oncall): thanks team. I'll wait 30m; if metrics hold, will close the incident and start write-up. :white_check_mark:
Priya Shah: monitoring. leaving logs and traces in /incidents/2139991234/artifacts/ (link: https://internal.redwood/artifacts/2139991234).
Mike Chen: embedding repro script for calibration test in the artifacts folder.
CS Team: will follow up with customers once postmortem has remediation timeline.
Jordan (oncall): last check: p95=390ms p99=1.2s. looks stable. marking 'mitigated' in the incident tracker.
incident-bot: Incident status updated to MITIGATED at 2026-02-12T21:55:10Z.
Jordan (oncall): handing off to Alex for postmortem. please include root cause hypothesis: insufficient calibration samples for int8-low on long-context workloads causing attention kernel tail spikes; verify config drift during canary ramp.
Lena Torres: noted. I'll include kernel-level flamegraphs and KV latency distribution in the postmortem.
Priya Shah: thanks everyone. closing thread for now, will reopen if p99 resurges.
